LanguageData.SJP_SharedJoysMissing: Shared Joys is not loaded. Only the placeless activity menu is active.
LanguageData.SJP_ExtendBuildingsDesc: Lets "Relax at ..." and autonomous events use art pieces, meditation foci and graves, which no JoyGiverDef lists by name.
LanguageData.SJP_EnableActivityMenuDesc: Adds "Invite ... to an activity" on a colonist, for recreation that has no building to click: walks, skygazing, swimming, reading, meditation, drugs and treats.
LanguageData.SJP_FixBugsDesc: Two corrections applied on top of Shared Joys: a seat is recognised by building.isSittable alone, instead of also matching any defName containing "bench" or "seat" (which catches research and tailoring benches); and the free-slot count on a joy building ignores reservations belonging to other jobs, so a hauler or a repairer no longer makes the spot look full.\nTurn this off if Shared Joys fixes them upstream.
